messages:
maria: FYI customer StressUser (tenant: stressuser-42) reports they were suddenly locked out of the console and can't run models. Getting 403s on model list and billing page. This started ~09:10 UTC after the perms merge earlier today. Can someone triage?

arik: On it. Which deploy/PR rolled? any deploy id in the incident channel?

maria: Deploy bot showed `deploy/infra#742` merged at 09:02. @deploy-bot posted rollout complete at 09:05. Customer first pinged support at 09:09.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: deploy/infra#742 -> production (canary 09:02 -> 09:05).

shaun: 742 was the RBAC role-shape refactor (flatten role inheritance + attribute-based mapping). Known to be risky for tenants that rely on implicit inheritance. I suspect role bindings were collapsed. Any audit logs for stressuser-42?

audit-bot: detected policy-change for tenant=stressuser-42 by actor=infra-bot at 09:03. Removed bindings: [tenant-admin -> team/ops], added bindings: [project-level-read -> team/ops].

jessica: If audit-bot shows tenant-admin removed that's likely the cause. Short-term mitigation: grant tenant-admin back manually. Command: `redwood-admin iam grant --tenant stressuser-42 --principal team/ops --role tenant-admin` (requires SRE/admin perms).

arik: Running the grant now (using emergency session).

arik: output: `OK: binding created for principal=team/ops role=tenant-admin tenant=stressuser-42`

maria: Customer confirms console access restored and can list models. They still see a 403 on billing page, testing.

jessica: Billing page uses separate permission `billing.view` scoped via org-admin role. Run `redwood-admin iam add-attr` to ensure org role mapping preserved, but first check if any org bindings were also flattened.

shaun: I pulled the policy diff from the rollout: the merge replaced wildcard inheritance with explicit mappings and there was a missing rule mapping `team/ops` -> org-admin for tenant-linked billing. Root cause: config generation omitted cross-scope mapping for tenants that were using inherited org roles.

maria: Customer confirms billing page is working after a follow-up grant from SRE. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

arik: Plan: (1) rollback the RBAC generation change from deploy/infra#742 to stop further accidental drops if rollout hits other tenants (canary already passed, but we'll pause remaining rollout), (2) patch mapping generator to preserve explicit org->tenant mappings, (3) run a targeted audit across tenants for removed tenant-admin/org-admin bindings and auto-create safe fallbacks, (4) postmortem + customer communication.

shaun: Agreed. Adding vuln/ops label for the role-surface risk. I'll own the patch. ETA for patch + canary redeploy ~2 hours.

jessica: I've notified the CSM and legal about scoped impact and prepared a templated customer message. We'll inform affected customers and offer a follow-up security review.

maria: Customer accepted the workaround and asked for a short summary when fixed. I'll mark the ticket as pending SRE action. Thanks all.

arik: Paused the remainder of the rollout at 09:18 UTC. Filed rollback PR: infra#743.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by arik at 09:18 (reason: RBAC regression observed).

shaun: Patch PR opened (infra#744) to restore explicit org->tenant mapping tests and add an integration test that simulates tenant inheritance. Requesting review.

maria: Closing thread for now, will reopen if customer reports regression after patch.
